findings.location: 모형을 덮고 확인하기 / 3. 변경 전에 고를 행동: 원래 예약 유지 또는 변경
findings.problem: The learner can attend only in the morning, but the original booking is Friday afternoon. Presenting retention as an available solution contradicts the stated personal constraint; the model calls both feasible.
findings.proposal: Replace task3 with an inquiry-method alternative instead of retaining an unusable booking. Add to the new factual material: KO ‘변경 문의는 직접 방문하거나 전화로 할 수 있어요.’ EN ‘You can enquire about a change in person or by phone.’ DE ‘Eine Änderung kannst du persönlich oder telefonisch anfragen.’ Task3: KO ‘변경을 문의할 두 방법을 -거나로 말해요.’ EN ‘Use -거나 to name the two ways to enquire about changing the booking.’ DE ‘Nenne die beiden Möglichkeiten für die Änderungsanfrage mit -거나.’ Hidden possible answer ‘직접 가거나 전화로 물어볼 수 있어요.’ Keep Sunday morning selection and final confirmation unchanged.

findings.location: 새 시간표로 독립 확인 / 모델: 다음 버스는 두 시 반에 출발하고
findings.problem: The section calls the performance independent but displays the complete output and recognition answers without a concealment instruction.
findings.proposal: Insert before the check: KO ‘앞의 시범, 아래 KO·EN·DE 답과 번역은 가려요. 새 사실과 과제만 보고 먼저 답하고, 도움을 열면 지원받은 수행으로 기록해요.’ EN ‘Hide the earlier models and the KO/EN/DE answers and translations below. First respond using only the new facts and prompts; opening help makes the attempt supported.’ DE ‘Decke die bisherigen Vorbilder sowie die folgenden KO/EN/DE-Antworten und Übersetzungen ab. Antworte zuerst nur anhand der neuen Angaben und Aufgaben; mit Hilfe zählt der Versuch als gestützt.’ Put responses in a facilitator-only or closed details block after the task. Keep the new factual material visible.

findings.location: 새 시간표로 독립 확인 / 14:45 and 두 시 사십오 분
findings.problem: The independent spoken-time answer needs 사십오, but the explicit A1.2-01 number preparation only supplies 10/15/20/30/50 minutes. This manuscript provides 사십오 only in the solution, so keeping the answer hidden exposes an unprepared number form.
findings.proposal: Before the new timetable, add a brief supported number step separate from its solution: KO ‘새 숫자 준비: 40분은 사십 분, 45분은 사십오 분이에요. 1:45 시계를 보고 한 시 사십오 분이라고 말해 봐요. 이 도움을 확인한 뒤 새 시간표로 가요.’ EN ‘Prepare two new minute numbers: 40 = 사십, 45 = 사십오. Practise 1:45 as 한 시 사십오 분, then move to the new timetable.’ DE ‘Bereite zwei neue Minutenzahlen vor: 40 = 사십, 45 = 사십오. Übe 1:45 als 한 시 사십오 분 und gehe danach zum neuen Fahrplan.’ If this step is skipped, accept numeric/time selection as comprehension and do not score missing 사십오 as failure of 마다/source grammar.

findings.location: 고택 · 괜찮은 척하지 않아도 돼요 / 몰래 곶감을 먹은 뒤
findings.problem: The manuscript substitutes dried persimmons for the soft ripe persimmon in the exact LEVEL_STORY micro-conflict and canonical STORY_V3_5 lines238/555. This changes an established LQ07 detail.
findings.proposal: Replace only ‘몰래 곶감을 먹은 뒤’ with ‘몰래 홍시를 먹은 뒤’; EN ‘after sneaking some dried persimmons’ with ‘after secretly eating a soft ripe persimmon’; DE ‘heimlich getrocknete Kakis gegessen’ with ‘heimlich eine weiche, reife Kaki gegessen’. Preserve the no-diagnosis/no-treatment learning boundary and the rest of the scene.

findings.location: 새 장소에서 독립 확인 / 친구에게 네 규칙·제안을 말하고 기다릴 장소를 찾아요
findings.problem: The exact unit can-do includes requesting needed help. Learner tasks state rules or ask permission; the help exchange is only in the supplied story/script, so the learner never actually requests help.
findings.proposal: Add one separate turn after the workshop rules: KO ‘이번 역할은 앞치마를 입을 때 도움이 필요해요. 직원에게 도움을 요청하고 답을 기다리세요.’ EN ‘In this role, you need help putting on the apron. Ask a staff member for help and wait for the response.’ DE ‘In dieser Rolle brauchst du Hilfe beim Anziehen der Schürze. Bitte das Personal um Hilfe und warte auf die Antwort.’ Hidden acceptable answer ‘도움이 필요해요.’ Also accept ‘도와주세요’ as a natural alternative, with chunk support if needed; do not assess unintroduced 돕다 inflection. Partner acknowledges and offers help. This stays practical and nonmedical.

findings.location: 다른 자료로 혼자 확인하기 / 레나는 어제 포스터를 만들었어요 → 만든 포스터
findings.problem: The new past-modifier task introduces 만들다→만든, whose ㄹ deletion is absent from the received-letter model. A small preparation step would keep the task focused on time reference rather than an unseen stem change.
findings.proposal: Before the new poster task add a short supported form note: KO ‘만들다의 지난 행동 수식은 만든이에요. ㄹ은 ㄴ 앞에서 빠져요. 만든 모형처럼 익힌 뒤 새 포스터를 가리켜요.’ EN ‘The past-action modifier of 만들다 is 만든: ㄹ drops before ㄴ. Practise with 만든 모형 (“a model someone made”) before identifying the new poster.’ DE ‘Das Attribut für eine vergangene Handlung von 만들다 lautet 만든: ㄹ entfällt vor ㄴ. Übe 만든 모형 („ein angefertigtes Modell“), bevor du das neue Plakat bezeichnest.’ Alternatively keep this first use supported; don't treat failure on ㄹ deletion alone as failure to distinguish past and planned actions.

findings.location: 다른 사람과 다른 공지로 확인하기 / 1–3 inline examples and 새 공지 inline answers
findings.problem: The author note calls these independent tasks, but their complete model answers and translated notice solutions are visible in the same numbered lines. As printed, they only support guided reproduction/reading.
findings.proposal: Insert before the check: KO ‘앞의 시범, 아래 KO·EN·DE 답과 번역은 가려요. 새 사실과 과제만 보고 먼저 답하고, 도움을 열면 지원받은 수행으로 기록해요.’ EN ‘Hide the earlier models and the KO/EN/DE answers and translations below. First respond using only the new facts and prompts; opening help makes the attempt supported.’ DE ‘Decke die bisherigen Vorbilder sowie die folgenden KO/EN/DE-Antworten und Übersetzungen ab. Antworte zuerst nur anhand der neuen Angaben und Aufgaben; mit Hilfe zählt der Versuch als gestützt.’ Put responses in a facilitator-only or closed details block after the task. Keep the new factual material visible. Split each numbered learner prompt from its example. For the notice, show the Korean notice first; translation is optional support, not unassisted Korean-reading evidence. Accept polite 해요 speech to the friend as a natural relation-compatible alternative; no new informal conjugation test is required.
